title: Print the first, middle and last company
description:
Print the first, middle and last company.

Python-Gym adaptation: implement as first_middle_last_company(companies), where companies has an odd number of items, returning a tuple (first, middle, last).
hints: The first company is at index 0 and the last is at index -1.
For an odd-length list, floor-dividing the length by 2 gives the middle index.
expected_behavior: Returns a 3-tuple of (first, middle, last) company names.
explanation: Indexing 0 and -1 gets the ends, and len(companies) // 2 lands on the middle element for an odd-length list.
